TileStructure.Forest.correlation_near_tr.statement: (Lemma 7.4.6) Let $u_1,u_2\in t$ with $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$, and let $f_1,f_2$ be bounded with compact support. Then $$\Big\|\int_X T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_1)}f_1(x)\,\overline{T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f_2(x)}\,dx\Big\|\le C_{7.4.6}(a,n)\,\big\|\mathbf 1_{\mathcal I(u_1)}\,S^*_{u_1}f_1\big\|_{L^2}\,\big\|\mathbf 1_{\mathcal I(u_1)}\,S^*_{u_2}f_2\big\|_{L^2},$$ where $T^*_{\mathfrak C}$ is the adjoint Carleson sum over $\mathfrak C$ and $S^*_{u}$ denotes the adjoint boundary operator $t.\mathrm{adjointBoundaryOperator}\,u$.
TileStructure.Forest.correlation_near_tr.sketch: Rewrites the pairing via the adjointness identity (adjointCarlesonSum_adjoint), applies the tree projection estimate (Lemma 7.2.1) to the tree $\mathfrak T(u_1)$, and controls the projection of $|T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f_2|$ onto the cubes $\mathcal J_6(u_1)$ by Lemma 7.6.2 (bound_for_tree_projection).

TileStructure.Forest.𝓙₆.statement: For a forest $t$ and a tile $u_1$, defines the collection of dyadic cubes $\mathcal J_6(u_1)\subseteq\mathrm{Grid}(X)$, the set $\mathcal J'$ from the start of Section 7.6 (named differently to distinguish it from the $\mathcal J'$ of Section 7.5).

TileStructure.Forest.thin_scale_impact_p.statement: Let $u_1\in t$ and $J\in\mathcal J_6(u_1)$, and let $\mathfrak p$ be a tile such that the balls $B(c(\mathfrak p),8D^{s(\mathfrak p)})$ and $B(c(J),8D^{s(J)})$ are not disjoint and $s(J)-C_{7.6.3}(a,n)<s(\mathfrak p)$, where $D=D(a)$ is the default doubling parameter. Then $d(c(\mathfrak p),c(J))<16D^{s(\mathfrak p)+C_{7.6.3}(a,n)+2}$, and there is a cube $J'$ with $J<J'$ and $s(J')=s(J)+1$ together with a tile $\mathfrak p'\in\mathfrak T(u_1)$ such that $\mathcal I(\mathfrak p')\subseteq B(c(J'),100D^{s(J')+1})$.
TileStructure.Forest.thin_scale_impact_p.sketch: Uses the definition of $\mathcal J_6$ via $\mathcal J$ and $\mathcal J_0$ and passes to the parent cube $J'$ of $J$ (Grid.succ); the distance bound follows from the overlapping balls and the scale condition.

TileStructure.Forest.thin_scale_impact_k.statement: Let $u_1,u_2\in t$ with $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$, let $\mathfrak p\in\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)$, let $J\in\mathcal J_6(u_1)$, suppose the balls $B(c(\mathfrak p),8D^{s(\mathfrak p)})$ and $B(c(J),8D^{s(J)})$ are not disjoint, and suppose $s(J)-C_{7.6.3}(a,n)<s(\mathfrak p)$. Then $$2^{Z(n+1)-1}<2^{a(\mathbb c\,a^2(C_{7.6.3}(a,n)+2+1)+9)}\cdot2^{Zn/2},$$ where $Z=Z(a)$ is the default parameter $\mathrm{defaultZ}(a)$ and $\mathbb c$ is the absolute constant $𝕔$. (This relation is later shown to be contradictory.)
TileStructure.Forest.thin_scale_impact_k.sketch: Applies thin_scale_impact_prelims to obtain the distance bound and a tile of $\mathfrak T(u_1)$ near the parent of $J$, then compares frequency distances of dilated tiles using properties of compatible function distances to derive the inequality.

TileStructure.Forest.e763.statement: (Equation (7.6.3) of Lemma 7.6.2) Let $u_1,u_2\in t$ with $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$, and let $f$ be bounded with compact support. Then $$\Big\|P_{\mathcal J_6(u_1)}\big|T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f\big|\Big\|_{L^2}\le\sum_{k=\lfloor C_{7.6.3}(a,n)\rfloor}^{2S}\Bigg(\sum_{J\in\mathcal J_6(u_1)}\mu(J)^{-1}\Big(\int_J\sum_{\mathfrak p}\big\|T^*_{\mathfrak p}f(y)\big\|\,d\mu(y)\Big)^2\Bigg)^{1/2},$$ where the inner sum runs over $\mathfrak p\in\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)$ such that $J$ meets $B(c(\mathfrak p),8D^{s(\mathfrak p)})$ and $s(\mathfrak p)=s(J)-k$, and $S=\mathrm{defaultS}(X)$.
TileStructure.Forest.e763.sketch: Decomposes the adjoint sum by the scale difference $k=s(J)-s(\mathfrak p)$; the key relation thin_scale_impact_key (which is contradictory) rules out tiles with $k<\lfloor C_{7.6.3}(a,n)\rfloor$, and the triangle inequality in $L^2$ gives the sum over $k$.

TileStructure.Forest.e764_preCS.statement: (Equation (7.6.4) of Lemma 7.6.2, before Cauchy–Schwarz) Let $u_1,u_2\in t$ with $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$, and let $f$ be bounded with compact support. Then $\big\|P_{\mathcal J_6(u_1)}|T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f|\big\|_{L^2}$ is at most $$C_{2.1.3}(a)\,2^{4a}\sum_{k=\lfloor C_{7.6.3}(a,n)\rfloor}^{2S}\Bigg(\sum_{J\in\mathcal J_6(u_1)}\mu(J)^{-1}\Big(\sum_{I}\int_J\mathbf 1_{B(c(I),8D^{s(I)})}(y)\,M_{\mathcal B}f\cdots\Big)\cdots\Bigg)\cdots,$$ where $I$ ranges over cubes with $s(I)=s(J)-k$, $I$ disjoint from $\mathcal I(u_1)$, and $J$ meeting $B(c(I),8D^{s(I)})$; $M_{\mathcal B}$ is the maximal function (exponent 1) over the balls $\mathcal B$. (The remainder of the Lean statement is truncated in the source.)
TileStructure.Forest.e764_preCS.sketch: Starts from (7.6.3) (e763); each tile $\mathfrak p$ in the inner sum has $\mathcal I(\mathfrak p)$ disjoint from $\mathcal I(u_1)$ (otherwise overlap_implies_distance would put it in $\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)$), so the tiles are grouped by their cubes $I$ and $|T^*_{\mathfrak p}f|$ is bounded pointwise by a multiple of the indicator of $B(c(I),8D^{s(I)})$ times the maximal function.

TileStructure.Forest.e764_postCS.statement: (Equation (7.6.4) of Lemma 7.6.2, after Cauchy–Schwarz) Let $u_1,u_2\in t$ with $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$, and let $f$ be bounded with compact support. Then $$\Big\|P_{\mathcal J_6(u_1)}\big|T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f\big|\Big\|_{L^2}\le\Big(C_{2.1.3}(a)\,2^{11a+2}\sum_{k=\lfloor C_{7.6.3}(a,n)\rfloor}^{2S}D^{-k\kappa/2}\Big)\,\big\|\mathbf 1_{\mathcal I(u_1)}M_{\mathcal B}f\big\|_{L^2},$$ where $\kappa=\kappa(a)$ is the default parameter and $S=\mathrm{defaultS}(X)$.
TileStructure.Forest.e764_postCS.sketch: Applies Cauchy–Schwarz to the bound e764_preCS and simplifies, using the definitions of $\mathcal J_6$, $\mathcal J$, $\mathcal J_0$ and dilated tiles to obtain the factor $D^{-k\kappa/2}$ for each $k$.

TileStructure.Forest.bound_for_tree_proj.statement: (Lemma 7.6.2) Let $u_1,u_2\in t$ with $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$, and let $f$ be bounded with compact support. Then $$\Big\|P_{\mathcal J_6(u_1)}\big|T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f\big|\Big\|_{L^2}\le C_{7.6.2}(a,n)\,\big\|\mathbf 1_{\mathcal I(u_1)}M_{\mathcal B}f\big\|_{L^2}.$$
TileStructure.Forest.bound_for_tree_proj.sketch: Follows from e764_postCS by bounding the constant $C_{2.1.3}(a)2^{11a+2}\sum_kD^{-k\kappa/2}$ by $C_{7.6.2}(a,n)$.
